newsitem.title: USA: USDA to continue buys of surplus Alaska salmon.
newsitem.headline: USDA to continue buys of surplus Alaska salmon.

text.p: The U.S. Department of Agriculture will buy up to $12 million worth of Alaska pink and chum salmon to feed the nation's poor, Gov. Tony Knowles said Wednesday.
The decision continues a policy started last year, when the department bought $14 million worth of pink salmon, the cheapest and most plentiful of Alaska's five salmon species.
The federal government's salmon purchase will help Alaska fishermen, who have struggled with low prices that result from a market glut of salmon, said Knowles, a Democrat.
All USDA purchases will be made on a competitive-bid basis, the governor said.
Knowles was notified of the decision Wednesday. He said the department will make a formal announcement Thursday.
